patch.replacement: B to an appended eight-byte main-module veneer
patch.abi: Original root receives r0=context and has no consumed return value at its two direct callers (main+0xbbd8d8 and main+0xbbe714). Preserve r4-r11, SP, d8-d15. The shim calls native C under guest TLS, returns to original LR on success and stops through host bridge service 0x252 on failure. No displaced instruction replay: the entire root body is replaced.

nvn_abi.queries: Real r0/r1 64-bit query results; never fabricate handles or GPU addresses.
